content.text: Running expenses of the Parliamentary Service
The amount of €5,008,605 is appropriated for the lease of the Parliament building in terms of the Budget Measures Implementation Act, 2012.
The amount of €8,955,395 is appropriated for the expenses of the Parliamentary Service in terms of the Parliamentary Service Act (Cap. 562).
The total vote is appropriated in terms of the Parliamentary Service Act (Cap.562).
